id: \bI'm afraid about this. What if I lose?
en: \bI'm afraid about this. What if I lose?

id: \bBrock: I figured you would be here.
en: \bBrock: I figured you would be here.
it: \bBrock: Immaginavo che ti avrei trovato qui.

id: \bI know you're busy preparing for the league, so I think a battle might help you out.
en: \bI know you're busy preparing for the league, so I think a battle might help you out.
it: \bSo che sei impegnato a prepararti per la Lega, quindi penso che una lotta potrebbe aiutarti.

id: \bBrock: Great battle \PN! If you want I can groom one of your Pokémon. It may help it in battle.
en: \bBrock: Great battle \PN! If you want I can groom one of your Pokémon. It may help it in battle.
it: \bBrock: Gran bella lotta, \PN! Se vuoi, posso curare l'aspetto di uno dei tuoi Pokémon. Potrebbe aiutarlo in lotta.

id: \bBrock: Which Pokémon do you want me to groom?
en: \bBrock: Which Pokémon do you want me to groom?
it: \bBrock: A quale Pokémon vuoi che faccia la toelettatura?

id: \bBrock: There! \v[2] looks a lot better now!
en: \bBrock: There!  \v[2] looks a lot better now!
it: \bBrock: Ecco fatto!  \v[2] ha un aspetto molto migliore ora!

id: \bGood to see you \PN. I'm one of Professor Oak's aides. He would like to see you as soon as possible.
en: \bGood to see you \PN. I'm one of Professor Oak's aides. He would like to see you as soon as possible.
it: \bChe bello vederti, \PN. Sono uno degli assistenti del Professor Oak. Vorrebbe vederti il prima possibile.

id: \rI'm so ready for this. You don't stand a chance.
en: \rI'm so ready for this. You don't stand a chance.

id: \bI could use some last minute practice. The Grand Festival is going to be tough.
en: \bI could use some last minute practice. The Grand Festival is going to be tough.
it: \bMi farebbe comodo un po' di allenamento dell'ultimo minuto. Il Grand Festival sarà dura.

id: \rThat shop looks shady to me.\nWhat do you think?
en: \rThat shop looks shady to me.\nWhat do you think?
it: \rQuel negozio mi sembra losco.\nTu che ne pensi?

id: \bI need some more training before it starts.
en: \bI need some more training before it starts.
it: \bMi serve ancora un po' di allenamento prima che inizi.
